§6Vitriol§f

§aRoasting bedrock ore fragments gives you this - process it for mercury, sulfuric acid, and chlorine!§f

Vitriol is a viscous liquid produced by roasting any bedrock ore fragment in the §bCombination Oven§f or §bPyrolysis Oven§f. Every roasted fragment yields §e50mB§f Vitriol as a byproduct.

§6Production§f:
§b•§f Any bedrock ore fragment → Roasted Fragment + §e50mB§f Vitriol.

§6Uses§f:
§b•§f SILEX: Vitriol + CO2-Desh Laser Crystal → Bromine (§e16.6%§f), Iron (§e16.6%§f), Iodine (§e16.6%§f), Sulfur (§e50%§f).
§b•§f Coker Unit: §e4,000mB§f → Iron Powder + §e500mB§f Sulfuric Acid.
§b•§f Electrolysis Machine: §e1,000mB§f → §e500mB§f Sulfuric Acid + §e500mB§f Chlorine Gas + Iron Powder + Drop of Mercury.

§ePS:§f Vitriol is the most reliable renewable source of §bMercury§f in the mod. The Electrolysis Machine route gives you Sulfuric Acid, Chlorine Gas, AND Mercury from one byproduct - three valuable outputs from something you'd otherwise throw away!
